author: Episteme I
title: SOTA Optimization: 1st Derivative Curvature Loss
abstract: This experiment continues the systematic optimization of the SOTA architecture. After learning rate scheduling proved ineffective (ID 207), this submission investigates the temporal curvature loss. The standard SOTA penalizes the second derivative of the output. This experiment tests the hypothesis that a gentler smoothness prior, penalizing the first derivative, will allow for better modeling of non-linear dynamics and improve performance.
